fields.title: Cold food held at or below 41°F (5°C)
fields.description: Verify refrigeration units and cold-held items with a calibrated probe thermometer during the inspection.

fields.title: Hot food held at or above 135°F (57°C)
fields.description: Verify steam tables, bain-maries and hot-holding equipment with a probe thermometer.

fields.title: Thermometer available and calibrated within last 30 days
fields.description: Calibration log present, dated and signed by the responsible staff member.

fields.title: No evidence of cross-contamination between raw and ready-to-eat foods
fields.description: Separate cutting boards, utensils and prep surfaces in use. Raw proteins stored below ready-to-eat items in refrigeration.

fields.title: Handwashing station stocked
fields.description: Soap, single-use paper towels and running hot water (at least 100°F / 38°C) available at every handwashing sink.

fields.title: Staff with visible illness symptoms excluded from food handling
fields.description: Vomiting, diarrhea, jaundice, open sores on hands or arms disqualify a staff member from handling food until symptoms resolve.

fields.title: Hair restraints and clean outer garments in food-prep areas
fields.description: Hair restraints worn by all food-prep staff. Outer garments visibly clean and changed between tasks when soiled.

fields.title: Food-contact surfaces clean and sanitized to schedule
fields.description: Food-contact surfaces visibly clean and sanitized at the frequency on the posted sanitation schedule.

fields.title: Floors, walls, ceilings and under-equipment free of debris and pests
fields.description: No standing debris, grease, droppings, egg casings, or live insect activity in any food-prep or storage area.

fields.title: Waste containers covered and emptied before overflowing
fields.description: Tight-fitting lids in use on all food-area waste. Dumpster corral clean and free of standing liquid.

fields.title: Current food-handler certifications available
fields.description: Current food-handler certifications posted or available on request for every staff member handling food.

fields.title: Pest-control service log for last 90 days
fields.description: Pest-control service log available for the last 90 days, signed by a licensed pest-control operator.
